description: This file defines the AveragingCachePressureMonitor class which implements cache pressure monitoring by averaging pressure values over time, including logic for state transition and logging.

classes.name: AveragingCachePressureMonitor
classes.description: Implements cache pressure monitoring based on averaging pressure values over all contributions, with logic for pressure calculation and state change logging.

methods.name: AveragingCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the cache pressure monitor with optional custom thresholds and monitor.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a contribution to cache pressure, weighting unhealthy contributions more heavily.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines whether the cache is currently under pressure based on calculated pressure.

methods.name: CalculatePressure
methods.description: Calculates current cache pressure and updates pressure state, logs transitions.

methods.name: LogDebugIngestingMessagesTooFast
methods.description: Logs a debug message indicating cache pressure is too high, throttling is needed.

methods.name: LogDebugMessageIngestionIsHealthy
methods.description: Logs a debug message indicating cache pressure is within healthy thresholds.
